desc: 蓝白冷调详情页，琥珀小瓶口服液，十一镜从痛点到收口
leaf: 犬猫肠道护理口服液（琥珀玻璃小瓶加绿橙波带白盒）
name: 犬猫肠道溶菌酶口服液款

shots.intent: 首屏用矢车菊蓝冷调版面与琥珀小瓶同框拿下停留，一秒建立犬猫肠道护理口服液的剂型认知
shots.textZone: 顶部一枚胶囊 kicker 位与两行主标题带，其下左侧四行勾选短语栏

shots.intent: 在纯色版面上把四条核心接受度主张压成一行胶囊，替代源图里空洞的口号堆叠，一秒读完
shots.textZone: 上部主标题带，其下四枚胶囊主张位，下部深蓝色带内一行副标题位

shots.intent: 用三格日常肠胃不适现象让犬猫主人立刻对号入座，把软便、厌食与精神差的摩擦放大成解决需求
shots.textZone: 顶部两行主标题带与一枚胶囊副标位，三卡下方各一枚实色标签带文字位

shots.intent: 把痛点立刻接上可代入的日常喂食时刻，让买家想象自己在家里把一小管口服液喂完的场景
shots.textZone: 左上主标题带与一行短句位，其下一枚胶囊标签位

shots.intent: 用两枚圆窗加中部三枚气泡胶囊把作用机理可视化，替代口头保证，解释为什么温和也有效
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带与一枚胶囊副标位，两枚圆窗下方各一行标签位，三枚气泡内各一行短标签位

shots.intent: 用左栏实心编号圆片加短说明条把四条选择理由讲成可扫读的结构，右栏用仰角产品图承接机理屏
shots.textZone: 顶部色带主标题位，左栏四行各一枚小标题位加一行短句位，右栏产品图区

shots.intent: 微距呈现琥珀玻璃通透感、瓶颈刻线与瓶盖滚花，用可见材质与封装替代口头质量承诺
用同构六格细线图标把原料、工厂、品控一类的选择理由讲成可扫读的墙，只靠抽象图元背书不写认证
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题位与一行短句位，六格下方各一行实色标签位

shots.intent: 把大小两档小瓶与纸盒放到同一俯视场里平铺对比，替买家自己判断该选哪一档，省掉问客服
shots.textZone: 顶部主标题带，两档各一枚尺寸引线占位与一行适用短标签位

shots.intent: 用干净的双栏规格卡一次答完名称、对象、成分与喂法疑虑，把源图带款号二维码的贴片换成中性信息表
shots.textZone: 顶部色带主标题位，左栏六行字段标签配占位值，右栏照片卡

shots.intent: 收口回到首屏同一冷蓝底，用仰视气势把一小管口服液拍成爱宠肠胃的定心丸，给一个低摩擦下单动作
shots.textZone: 上半区主标题带与一行副标题位，右下圆角胶囊按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: two linked systems held to one language: cornflower-blue clinical screens #4A78DE carrying one soft vertical light-ray band in #FFFFFF and one faint concentric halo ring centred behind the product, used for the opening, closing and companion screens, and flat ice-blue #E8F0FC or clean #FFFFFF infographic screens carrying rounded cards #FFFFFF with 20px corner radius and solid blue label bands #4A78DE with one soft translucent bubble pill in #C9D8F5, used for every mid-page screen; never a third background language
style.direction: clinical-trust pet oral-care blue infographic detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: single-family thin-line white glyphs #FFFFFF drawn at one stroke weight inside white rounded-square tiles ringed once in #4A78DE with one solid blue caption line beneath, translucent bubble pills in #C9D8F5 with #1B3A78 text, solid round numbered chips in #F2A03D with #FFFFFF digits, and one recurring hairline rule in #4A78DE as the section divider; no medical crosses, no organ diagrams, no realistic microbe illustrations, no seals, medals, ribbons or shield badges
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key clinical studio light from the front-top at 6000K with a large bounce fill, low-contrast soft gradients, one gentle rim along the amber glass shoulder and the carton edge, controlled matte speculars on the black ribbed screw cap, soft contact shadows under every object so nothing floats; the single home scene uses natural window light from the left at 5200K

noDrift: no QR codes, membership stickers or store badges
no white lab coats, stethoscopes or medical costumes on any animal
no medical crosses, organ diagrams or realistic microbe illustrations
no fabricated certifications, inspection seals, medals, ribbons, awards or sales figures
no approval, registration, batch, serial or article numbers
no numeric dose, volume, frequency, weight, shelf-life or pack-count values in rendered copy
no unfilled white placeholder frames and no magnifier pointing into empty space
no glossy 3D stock render arrows, sparkle graphics or gradient sticker bursts
style.presentationRules: the upright amber glass vial with its black ribbed screw cap and the white carton carrying the green-and-orange wave band are held at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and the same scale on every screen, grounded by soft contact shadows, their glass translucency, engraved neck ring, cap knurling, block layout and wave graphic true to the reference and never restyled; when a second vial appears the taller and the shorter reference silhouettes are kept exactly, never invented sizes; cats and dogs always cropped or turned away so no individual animal identity dominates; card corners fixed at 20px
style.surfaceSystem: glossy white acrylic podium #FFFFFF over a matte ice-blue panel #E8F0FC with one hairline azure edge #4A78DE, and one matte warm oak table #C49A63 holding a small ceramic dish in the single home scene
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif Chinese with one headline weight per screen; headlines in #FFFFFF on blue fields and in #1B3A78 on ice-blue and white fields, capsule tag pills in #4A78DE with #FFFFFF text at 14-18pt, band captions and icon labels at 14-20pt, spec-row labels at 16pt; every rendered line is carried as a 「」 placeholder, never as source copy
